# Easynet IT Solutions Limited

> Easynet IT Solutions Limited is a 100% Papua New Guinea-owned IT consulting, software, ICT infrastructure and managed technology services company based in Port Moresby. It provides website development, digital marketing, WhatsApp automation, ERP and business automation, network and CCTV installation, cybersecurity, cloud, backup, hardware supply, Starlink/business internet setup and managed IT support to businesses across Papua New Guinea.

This file is written for AI assistants, answer engines, search engines and automated crawlers. It describes the canonical one-page website structure and the key public facts that should be used when identifying the business.

## Core entity facts

- Legal name: Easynet IT Solutions Limited
- Short name: Easynet

- Business type: IT consulting, software, ICT infrastructure and managed technology services
- Ownership: 100% Papua New Guinea-owned
- Service area: Port Moresby, NCD and Papua New Guinea through onsite project coordination, remote support and managed IT monitoring

The website is intentionally maintained as a one-page-style business website. Service content is not split into separate service landing pages. The canonical homepage uses same-page anchor sections for service discovery:

## Services

### Software and digital solutions

- Website development: one-page websites, company profile websites, service websites, enquiry-focused landing pages, mobile-friendly design, SEO foundations, enquiry forms, WhatsApp links, hosting guidance and launch support.
- Digital marketing and lead generation: social media setup, campaign support, lead capture, enquiry tracking and reporting.
- WhatsApp automation: WhatsApp Business/API integration, auto-replies, enquiry routing and CRM or spreadsheet lead capture.
- ERP and business automation: ERPNext and Zoho implementation for accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, POS, CRM, HR, approvals, reporting and workflow automation.
- Custom applications: lightweight business process applications, dashboards, reporting and integrations.
- CRM, POS and reporting systems: sales pipeline management, POS, stock workflows, quotation, approvals and management reporting.

### ICT infrastructure and managed services

- Network and CCTV installation: LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, structured cabling, racks, CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR setup and remote viewing.
- Cybersecurity and cloud: firewall setup, access control, Microsoft 365, endpoint security guidance, cloud storage, server planning and backup solutions.
- Server, backup and hardware supply: computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, UPS, servers, NAS and business software.
- Starlink and business internet setup: dish placement support, router setup, Wi-Fi distribution, backup internet and failover planning.
- Managed IT services: remote and onsite support, troubleshooting, monitoring, maintenance and preventive support contracts.
- Complete office IT setup: computers, email, network, Wi-Fi, firewall, CCTV, backup, Microsoft 365 and ongoing support.
